response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS base FROM film), k1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a, b.base FROM r, b WHERE r.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_a FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.base, m.mean_a FROM k1, m WHERE k1.a > m.mean_a) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(a - base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - mean_a) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM k2
